title: Prime Minister offers prayers to Maa Chandraghanta during Navratri
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has offered prayers to Maa Chandraghanta, the goddess of courage, peace and divine power. The Prime Minister prayed for the well-being of all and wished that everyone’s life remain filled with happiness, good fortune and success. The Prime Minister wrote on X; “नवरात्रि में आज साहस, शांति और दिव्य शक्ति की देवी मां चंद्रघंटा की करबद्ध वंदना! उनकी कृपा से सबका कल्याण हो। सभी का जीवन सुख-सौभाग्य एवं सफलता से सदैव परिपूर्ण रहे, यही मंगलकामना है।”'
